title: First week of life seems crucial for future allergy and eczema risk | New Scientist
description: The mainstream view is that there are no particularly critical phases in the development of the immune system, but a study of hundreds of infants suggests otherwise
author: Carissa Wong

title: Brain area discovered that may be critical for viable pregnancies | New Scientist
description: A newly discovered part of the brain is essential for successful embryo implantation in mice. It may help to explain why some pregnancies and IVF attempts fail
author: Alice Klein

title: ’s geographic poles wander more than we had thought | New Scientist
description: A phenomenon known as true polar wander, different to the movement of the magnetic poles, may be more common and more dramatic than previously known
author: James Woodford

title: Ukraine rolls out drone-stopping razor fence to thwart attacks | New Scientist
description: Most of the drones being used by Russia in the war with Ukraine are controlled by cables several tens of kilometres long. A new defensive tool cuts the cables to stop the drones
author: David Hambling

title: Elephants imitate each other when they produce deep rumbling sounds | New Scientist
description: African savannah elephants use a variety of calls to communicate, and now machine learning has shown that they tune their deepest sounds to match those of other nearby elephants
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: Placenta wrap hastens erection recovery after prostate surgery | New Scientist
description: Dried amniotic membranes from donated placentas can be wrapped around delicate nerves during prostate cancer surgery to hasten the time to a first erection after the procedure
author: Alice Klein
